Janet (ACME): Hey team — our embeddings started failing after the upgrade. Indexing job errors out with shape mismatch. Our index expects length 1024 but API returns 1536. Example curl + response (sanitized):

Janet (ACME): ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-large:2023-07-01","input":"test"}'
```

Janet (ACME): Response: `{ "data": [ { "embedding": [ /* length: 1536 */ ] } ] }`

Ryan: Ugh. Thanks for the report — can you paste the request_id? Also are you on Dedicated or Hosted?

Janet (ACME): request_id=req_0a1b2c3d, tenant=acme-corp, Dedicated (reserved pool). Pin in console shows model locked to open-embed-large:2023-07-01.

Ryan: tagging eng-ml 
Ryan: @Sasha @Luca can you triage? Looks like dimension drift after the model upgrade/pinning event.

Sasha: on it. Quick check of model catalog: open-embed-large:2023-07-01 -> 1024 dims, open-embed-large:2024-11-03 (v2) -> 1536 dims. We onboarded v2 last week.

Sasha: interesting: the tenant is pinned to :2023-07-01 but routing logs show some requests routed to :2024-11-03 around 17:40 UTC.

Luca: I pulled router traces for req_0a1b2c3d — routing-service resolved alias `open-embed-large` to `open-embed-large:latest` because node for :2023-07-01 was momentarily drained. There is a config flag that allows version fallback for latency SLOs. That fallback bypassed the shape compatibility gate.

Sasha: reproduction locally:
```bash
# pinned version explicit
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"open-embed-large:2023-07-01","input":"x"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# -> 1024

# alias or fallback
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"open-embed-large","input":"x"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# -> 1536
```

DeployBot: routing-service v3.14.2 rolled at 2024-11-03T17:41:00Z; config flag `allow_version_fallback_for_latency=true` is enabled in that rollout.

Luca: root cause summary: fallback path in routing-service allowed serving newer model variants when pinned version was unavailable; runtime didn't validate embedding vector length against tenant expectations, causing downstream index failures.

Ryan: mitigation plan (short term):
- disable fallback for pinned tenants (toggle config)
- add runtime embedding-length validation and return explicit 4xx when mismatch occurs
- notify affected customers with remediation steps

Luca: I'm applying the config patch to disable fallback for pinned tenants now. Patching routing-service config at 18:04 UTC. OpsBot: incident created: INC-2024-5647 — Embedding dimension drift for tenant acme-corp. Assigned: eng-ml, routing, support.
